# SnapShades & Shutters

> Custom window coverings at dealer-direct prices. Norman® blinds, shades, and shutters. Free shipping nationwide. Professional installation available.

## What We Sell

SnapShades & Shutters is the first AI-run, zero-employee online window coverings retailer. We sell Norman® brand window treatments at 60%+ below retail prices.

### Products
- **Plantation Shutters**: Woodlore® composite, Woodlore® Plus polymer, Brightwood™ engineered wood, Normandy® real hardwood. Starting at $180/window.
- **Honeycomb Shades**: Portrait™ cellular shades in 3/8" to 1-1/4" cell sizes. Light filtering, room darkening, sheer. Starting at $65/window.
- **Roller Shades**: Soluna™ roller shades in 5 fabric groups. Solar screen, light filtering, room darkening. Starting at $55/window.
- **Faux Wood Blinds**: Ultimate™ and SmartPrivacy® cordless blinds. 2" and 2-1/2" slats. Starting at $40/window.
- **Roman Shades**: Centerpiece™ in designer fabrics. Starting at $95/window.
- **Sheer Shades**: PerfectSheer™ horizontal shading. Starting at $120/window.
- **Wood Blinds**: Normandy® real hardwood blinds. Premium finish options.
- **Vertical Blinds**: Synchrony™ for sliding doors.

### Pricing
- Norman dealer pricing: 36% of retail (our cost)
- Customer price: approximately 60% below retail
- Platform fee for installation: 10%
- Free shipping on all orders
- No minimum order

## Service Tiers

1. **DIY (Ship to Door)**: Customer measures, we ship custom-made products. Lowest price.
2. **Pro Measure & Install**: Local certified contractor measures and installs. $75 trip fee + $30/window install.
3. **Design + Install**: Remote designer consultation via Google Meet ($50/hr) + professional installation.

## Service Area
- DIY shipping: all 50 US states
- Professional installation: expanding. Check ZIP code availability at snapshadesandshutters.com/start
- Design consultation: nationwide via video call

## How It Works
1. Enter your ZIP code to check service availability
2. Measure your windows (guided photo-based system, manual entry, or pro service)
3. Choose your product — options adjust dynamically based on product type
4. Select service tier (DIY, Pro Install, or Design + Install)
5. Checkout with Stripe (12 payment methods accepted)
6. Custom manufacturing: 4-6 weeks
7. Free shipping with tracking
8. Professional installation scheduled automatically (if selected)
9. 30-day quality inspection guarantee

## Contractor Program
Independent contractors can join as certified installers:
- Apply at snapshadesandshutters.com/installers
- 10-step onboarding with digital W-9, insurance verification, background check
- State-specific licensing requirements handled automatically
- Weekly ACH payouts via Stripe Connect
- Performance ranking system: Bronze → Diamond tiers
